parameters.query: SELECT id, role, active FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'total_contacts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE is_archived = false AND ($1::int IS NULL OR owner_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities oo WHERE oo.contact_id = contacts.id AND oo.pipeline_id = $2))),
  'total_revenue', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Won' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'revenue_mtd', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Won' AND date_trunc('month', closed_at) = date_trunc('month', now()) AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'open_pipeline_value', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'open_pipeline_weighted', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value * COALESCE(probability, 0) / 100.0), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'active_deals', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'avg_deal_value', (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(deal_value), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'new_leads_30d', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE is_archived = false AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR owner_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities oo WHERE oo.contact_id = contacts.id AND oo.pipeline_id = $2))),
  'new_leads_mtd', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE is_archived = false AND date_trunc('month', created_at) = date_trunc('month', now()) AND ($1::int IS NULL OR owner_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities oo WHERE oo.contact_id = contacts.id AND oo.pipeline_id = $2))),
  'tasks_due_today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND is_completed = false AND due_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND ($1::int IS NULL OR user_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR opportunity_id IN (SELECT id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2) OR contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2 AND contact_id IS NOT NULL))),
  'tasks_overdue', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND is_completed = false AND due_at < now() AND ($1::int IS NULL OR user_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR opportunity_id IN (SELECT id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2) OR contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2 AND contact_id IS NOT NULL))),
  'funnel', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('stage_name', x.stage_name, 'count', x.cnt, 'value', x.val) ORDER BY x.ord), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT st.name AS stage_name, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) AS cnt, COALESCE(o.val, 0) AS val, st.display_order AS ord
    FROM stages st
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(deal_value) AS val FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2) GROUP BY stage_id) o ON o.stage_id = st.id
    WHERE st.name NOT ILIKE '%won%' AND st.name NOT ILIKE '%lost%' AND ($2::int IS NULL OR st.pipeline_id = $2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Closed Won' AS stage_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) AS val, 999999 AS ord
    FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Won' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)
  ) x),
  'lead_sources', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('lead_source', COALESCE(lead_source, 'Unknown'), 'count', cnt)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT lead_source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM contacts WHERE is_archived = false AND ($1::int IS NULL OR owner_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities oo WHERE oo.contact_id = contacts.id AND oo.pipeline_id = $2)) GROUP BY lead_source ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) s),
  'win_loss', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'won_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Won'),
    'lost_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Lost'),
    'win_rate', CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Won', 'Lost')) = 0 THEN 0
                 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Won')::numeric / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Won', 'Lost')) * 100, 1) END
  ) FROM opportunities WHERE status IN ('Won', 'Lost') AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)),
  'team_leaderboard', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('user_id', t.user_id, 'name', t.name, 'revenue', t.revenue, 'won_deals', t.won_deals, 'open_deals', t.open_deals) ORDER BY t.revenue DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, COALESCE(w.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(w.cnt, 0) AS won_deals, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) AS open_deals
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT assigned_user, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(deal_value) AS revenue FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Won' AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2) GROUP BY assigned_user) w ON w.assigned_user = u.id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT assigned_user, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2) GROUP BY assigned_user) o ON o.assigned_user = u.id
    WHERE u.active = true
    ORDER BY COALESCE(w.revenue, 0) DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) t),
  'stalled_deals', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', sd.id, 'name', sd.name, 'value', sd.deal_value, 'owner_name', sd.owner_name, 'days_stalled', sd.days_stalled)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT o.id, o.name, o.deal_value, u.name AS owner_name,
      EXTRACT(DAY FROM now() - GREATEST(o.updated_at, COALESCE(la.last_activity, o.updated_at)))::int AS days_stalled
    FROM opportunities o
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.assigned_user
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT opportunity_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_activity FROM activities GROUP BY opportunity_id) la ON la.opportunity_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'Open' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)
      AND GREATEST(o.updated_at, COALESCE(la.last_activity, o.updated_at)) < now() - interval '7 days'
    ORDER BY days_stalled DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) sd),
  'task_completion', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'completed', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_completed = true),
    'total', COUNT(*),
    'rate', CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_completed = true)::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) END
  ) FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND ($1::int IS NULL OR user_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR opportunity_id IN (SELECT id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2) OR contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2 AND contact_id IS NOT NULL))),
  'monthly_revenue', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('month', to_char(m.month, 'Mon'), 'value', COALESCE(r.value, 0)) ORDER BY m.month), '[]'::json)
    FROM generate_series(date_trunc('year', now()), date_trunc('year', now()) + interval '11 months', interval '1 month') AS m(month)
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT date_trunc('month', closed_at) AS month, SUM(deal_value) AS value
      FROM opportunities
      WHERE status = 'Won' AND date_trunc('year', closed_at) = date_trunc('year', now()) AND ($1::int IS NULL OR assigned_user = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR pipeline_id = $2)
      GROUP BY date_trunc('month', closed_at)
    ) r ON r.month = m.month
  ),
  'upcoming_tasks', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'subject', subject, 'due_at', due_at)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, subject, due_at FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND is_completed = false AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND ($1::int IS NULL OR user_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR opportunity_id IN (SELECT id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2) OR contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2 AND contact_id IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY due_at ASC LIMIT 5) t2),
  'recent_activities', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'description', description, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT a.id, (COALESCE(u.name, 'Someone') || ' logged a ' || a.type || ': ' || COALESCE(a.subject, '(no subject)')) AS description, a.created_at FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE ($1::int IS NULL OR a.user_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR a.opportunity_id IN (SELECT id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2) OR a.contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM opportunities WHERE pipeline_id = $2 AND contact_id IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) r),
  'recent_contacts', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'lead_status', lead_status, 'owner_name', owner_name, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.id, TRIM(CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name)) AS name, c.lead_status, u.name AS owner_name, c.created_at FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.is_archived = false AND ($1::int IS NULL OR c.owner_id = $1) AND ($2::int IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opportunities oo WHERE oo.contact_id = c.id AND oo.pipeline_id = $2)) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) rc)
) AS result;
